Music goes on when you leave Coffer or the screen turns off, with its controls in a notification. When the vault locks, the track playing finishes with a key of its own, wiped when the music stops or ten minutes after it pauses; the rest of the queue waits for the vault to open.

The song\'s loudness as bars in place of the plain progress bar, worked out from the whole song as soon as it plays. The first time, the song is downloaded whole for it, even if you skip it; then it is shown at once. Kept on the phone, encrypted.

Encrypted pieces of files you opened or saved, kept so they open again without a download. Without the vault\'s keys they cannot be read.
Small pictures of photos, videos and song covers on the file icons, and the waveforms of songs played, encrypted with this phone\'s key like the names in the index.
Each is made once, as the file comes into view, from as little of it as will do: about 1 to 3 MB of traffic per file. Off, the ones made so far are deleted.
Keep opened files on the phone
Opening them again takes no time and no traffic. Off, every opening downloads the file again.
The cache is encrypted, but anyone with full access to the phone could see which files were opened lately and how big they are.
Only what is on this phone goes. Your files stay in Saved Messages and download again when opened.
The messages, chats and settings Telegram keeps for this account.
The list of files and folders, so the vault opens without reading Saved Messages. Names are encrypted in it.
Decrypted copies opened in other apps, removed about 10 minutes after opening or when the vault locks, and files on their way to Telegram.
Removes the vault and all its files from Saved Messages, on every device

This deletes every file in the vault and everything Coffer keeps for it in Saved Messages, for good and on every device. The recovery key will not open anything afterwards. Your own messages in Saved Messages stay.
Enter the vault password and type DELETE to confirm.
The vault was not fully deleted
Part of it may already be gone. Delete it again to finish.
Not active: Telegram limits download speed
Telegram does not slow down downloads for Premium accounts, so your files open and save faster. Everything else in Coffer works the same with or without Premium.
Without Premium, Telegram limits how fast files download, so large files take longer to open and save. Everything else in Coffer works the same.
Coffer keeps your files in your own Telegram Saved Messages, encrypted on this phone before they leave it. Names, folders and contents are never sent in the clear, and there is no Coffer server.

A file coming in replaces the one there once it is uploaded whole. Folders are merged.

Files offer Edit in another app: an editor such as WPS or OnlyOffice changes a decrypted copy, and each save goes back into the vault in place of the file. While you edit, and for an hour after the last save, the copy stays decrypted on the phone, also while Coffer is locked; a save made while locked goes in at the next unlock. Some apps, Microsoft Word and Excel among them, may open it only to read.
Show Coffer in the system file picker

Other apps can open vault files through the system file picker and save them back, as a password manager does with its database. An app gets only the files you pick there, and only while Coffer is unlocked. A file saved from another app goes into the vault in place of the old one; until it is sent, and for an hour after the last save, its copy stays decrypted on the phone, also while Coffer is locked.

New uploads are padded inside the encryption, so Telegram cannot tell a file by its exact size. Costs about 1 to 2 percent more traffic and space, a little more for very small files. Files already uploaded stay as they are.
How long Coffer stays open while you use other apps. Locking wipes the vault\'s keys from memory; you unlock again with the password, the recovery key or the fingerprint.
In the dark theme, black backgrounds for AMOLED screens, with frosted glass for bars, sheets and dialogs.
Take the colours from the wallpaper, as Android 12 and later allow. Off: Coffer\'s own blue and teal.
Use the new password from now on, on all your devices. The recovery key stays the same.
Asks for the current password or the recovery key first

The new password replaces the old one on all your devices. Your files and recovery key stay the same, and so does the key they are encrypted with: someone who knew the old password and kept a copy of the vault from your Telegram account could still open it. If you think that happened, move your files to a new vault.
